Each memory keeps its year for the other puzzles.

f_wedding.text: We got married in June of 1961 at St. Stanislaus church, the June after Walt proposed.

f_linda_born.text: Your mom Linda was born in 1963 at the Cherry Street apartment, the year before we moved to Maple Avenue.

f_pie.text: I won the blue ribbon for my cherry pie at the county fair in 1972, two summers after I started cooking at Lincoln Elementary.

f_met_walt.text: I met your grandpa at the Erie County Fair in 1958, the summer I turned eighteen. He lost three dollars trying to win me a stuffed bear.
